purpose: The work-list denominator for the OPAL_ANALYST atom_decomp page-by-page program (Andrew-direct 2026-08-11). Answers: how many Portal pages are there, which ones, and what is the program COMPLETE against.
status: UNRATIFIED -- prep offered to 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Z for the PRD. If the CTO PRD fixes a different page decomposition, the PRD governs and this is discarded.

grounding.claim_class: DESIRED (source-declared routing). A route declared here is not proof of a route served.

denominators.route_tag_count_caveat: A naive `grep -c '<Route'` returns 25 because '<Route' is a PREFIX of '<Routes' and matches both <Routes> wrappers (App.tsx:404, :540). The true <Route> count is 23. Recorded because the 2-tag gap was found by reconciling the enumeration against the count -- an unreconciled 25 would have left two phantom routes implied and unaccounted.
denominators.route_reconciliation: 23 = 15 protected analyst pages + 2 redirects + 1 dev demo (protected block, App.tsx:405-472, 18 tags) + 4 auth routes + 1 dashboard-wrapper route (auth block, :542-563, 5 tags).
denominators.nav_to_protected_route_parity: 15 of 15 -- every nav item resolves to a declared route, and every protected route appears in the nav. Zero orphan routes, zero dead nav links.

findings.severity: surface-only, NOT a claim of live exposure
findings.title: A dev demo route is declared unconditionally and carries no ProtectedRoute wrapper
findings.detail: App.tsx:470 declares /dev/page-surface-control with a bare element -- no <ProtectedRoute>, unlike all 15 analyst pages -- and it is absent from NAV_SECTIONS, so it is unreachable by clicking. It is not behind a feature flag or an import.meta.env.DEV guard at the route site.
findings.what_I_did_NOT_check: Whether it is present in the deployed PROD bundle, and whether CloudFront serves it. comp-routes was NOT run. Do not read this as 'an unauthenticated page is live on PROD' -- that claim is unmade and ungrounded.
findings.disposition: Hand to CTO~Z as a surface observation. Cheap to settle with one comp-routes behaviors call plus a deployed-bundle grep; I have not been tasked to.

findings.severity: scoping -- affects the PRD, not the estate
findings.title: NEWS IS NOT A PAGE, so 'page by page' does not reach it
findings.detail: There is no /news route. The news surface in the Portal is a PANEL: src/pages/MarketPerformance/panels/SentimentPanel/SentimentPanel.tsx, inside page 1 (/market). Behind it sits a 9-Lambda news-pipeline (news-ingestion-scheduler, news-trending-analysis, opal-news-layer3-curation, news-semantic-clustering, semantic-news-layer3-curation, semantic-trending-topics-portal-publisher, opal-news-ai-sentiment, keyword-intelligence-generator, opal-keyword-drilldown-generator).
findings.why_it_matters: Andrew named news as needing CLOSE atom_decomp and validation because of archival/unused residue. A page-grained TO for /market would scope the news subsystem as one panel among three -- structurally too small for what he asked for. This wants its own TO at SUBSYSTEM grain, not page grain.
findings.corroboration: src/config/features.ts documents USE_SEMANTIC_TRENDING as DEPRECATED (2026-02-24) with EventBridge schedules for semantic-news-layer3-curation and semantic-trending-topics-portal-publisher DELETED and the /api/general/semantic-trending/latest.json endpoint declared never-to-update -- a dead path still declared in source. Independent of, and consistent with, my 08-10 census F2 (720 orphaned history keys + dead drilldown leg).
findings.disposition: CTO~Z PRD decision. I am not adjudicating scope.

findings.severity: taxonomy (CLAUDE.md Rule 24 postulate ii, SAME GRAIN)
findings.title: 'Panel' is NOT a uniform sub-page grain across the Portal
findings.detail: Only 5 of 16 page directories use a panels/ subdirectory (MarketPerformance 3, FactorTilts 2, Valuation 2, Macroeconomics 1, Positioning 1). The other 11 organize differently or are single-file (ModelPortfolios is one 2463-line .tsx; TicketCenter is 1 file; AdvisorIntelligence is 27 files with no panels/ dir).
findings.why_it_matters: If the TO axis is PAGE, grain is uniform and the axis is sound. If anyone decomposes to PANEL, the axis silently mixes grains and the count means different things per page. Naming it now is cheaper than discovering it at TO 7.
findings.disposition: Recommend the TO axis stay PAGE-grained, with news as the one named subsystem-grained exception per F-2.

recommended_sequencing.rationale: Not authoritative -- CTO~Z owns sequencing. Offered so the ordering question arrives with a proposal attached.
wave_0: /portfolios -- CVO~Z runs it, validates method + vertical. Not mine.
wave_2_news_subsystem: news -- subsystem grain, close validation, residue cleanup (F-2)
recommended_sequencing.note: Waves 1/3 split read-only analytics from write/action surfaces because a write surface's atom_decomp has to model mutation paths, which is a different evidence set.

completion_definition: The program is complete when all 15 protected pages plus the news subsystem have a certified atom_decomp run under workflows/atom_decomposition/runs/ AND CVO~Z has landed semantics for each. 16 units total: 15 pages + 1 subsystem.
